summary: feat(settings): show the Firefox logo in the pairing v2 QR code
description:
Because:

- The pairing v2 QR code on ScanQR showed no Firefox logo.
- A fixed-pixel logo chip outgrows the excavated area on a fluid QR.

This commit:

- Passes the existing Firefox logo to QRCode from ScanQR.
- Sizes the QRCode logo chip as a percentage of the code size.
- Adds unit tests for the logo and the percentage sizing.

Closes FXA-14419
